seed: Start from the transitions where an action produced no change at all. Find what blocked the action in each case and write the blocking condition before the movement rule.

synth.notes:
Lights-out board on an 8-cell grid; only ACTION6 clicks act.
Blocking guard: clicks that hit no tile/operator bbox (inert glyph or empty cell) are no-ops (t12, t14, t17).
Tile: clicked editable tile toggles color_14<->color_15.
Operator: toggles its marker_14<->15 and tiles at (+-8,0)/(0,+-8); glyph neighbours untouched.
Unconfirmed: operator-on-operator chaining (never observed). Stateless, ALL PASS.
